text:
Avery López: FYI — saw a spike of 403s tonight from clients hitting /v1/generate with header `x-api-version: 2`. Quota shows consumed on both /v1 and /v2 resources. Anyone seeing double-counting?

Jon Park: Hmm, can you paste a raw request+router log? Also which SDK/version?

Avery López: curl example:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer ..." -H "x-api-version: 2" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
router log:
```
[RTR] route=/v1/generate -> shim=/v2/engines/fast-4k
[QUOTA] check(resource=/v1/generate, tenant=acct_42) -> ALLOWED
[QUOTA] charge(resource=/v2/engines/fast-4k, tenant=acct_42) -> CHARGED
```

Priya Singh: That's the root cause — our compatibility shim creates a translated target (v2 model path) but we run quota checks at both route and translated resource. Intended for per-route quotas + per-model quotas but doubled for default customers.

Marta Chen: Console telemetry also shows doubled tokens for some customers. Ops chart for acct_42 shows ~2x expected spend around 02:14 UTC.

Jon Park: Short-term mitig: in router, after mapping we should canonicalize resource id and run quota check only once. Quick patch: skip the original if translation occurred. I can open a hotfix PR if we agree.

Priya Singh: Need to be careful: some customers rely on per-route quotas (e.g., rate limits on /v1/legacy-only). We must preserve route-level quotas when configured. So logic: if tenant has explicit route_quota configured, run both; otherwise dedupe and attribute to canonical model tag.

Avery López: Good point. Proposed rollout: patch router with config flag `dedupe_quota_on_translation` default true; canary to 10% of traffic for 24h; update quota docs and console label to show canonical resource tag.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: router-hotfix-v0.1 -> canary (eng-platform-canary) by Jon Park

Jon Park: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/router/pulls/278 — includes unit tests and a metric `quota_dedupe_applied`.

Marta Chen: For dashboards: add a derived timeseries that uses canonical resource tag to show corrected spend. Also add a note in billing dashboard about potential prior overcounting and show affected window.

Priya Singh: Telemetry fix: change attribution tags for token metrics: `resource=canonical_model_id`, `route=original_path` (keep both but primary key is canonical_model_id). We should reprocess last 48h for affected tenants.

Avery López: Action items:
- Jon: hotfix + canary rollout (today)
- Priya: detection query to find tenants with >1.5x discrepancy (2h)
- Marta: dashboard changelog and billing note (tomorrow)
- Me: customer comms for anyone impacted (standby)

Jon Park: On it — starting canary deploy now. Will post status updates.

Avery López: Thanks. If we see regressions we can flip `dedupe_quota_on_translation=false` to restore old behavior until PR 278 is fully vetted. :thumbsup:
